question: Low interest rate leads to risky money flow into stock and consumer spending. Evaluate the data to verify the accuracy of this statement.
query: SELECT      AVG(interest_rate) AS avg_interest_rate,      COUNT(*) FILTER (         WHERE trading_volume > percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY trading_volume)     ) AS high_trading_volume_days,     SUM(CASE WHEN consumer_confidence_index IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS days_with_consumer_confidence FROM      finance_economics_dataset WHERE      interest_rate < [Threshold] -- Replace with actual low threshold value for 'low' GROUP BY      date;   (Note: `[Threshold]` should be replaced by an actual numerical representation of what you would consider a "low" interest rate. If not specified, it may require further discussion or domain knowledge to define.)
